chunks: My father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with them) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd and Ibrahim ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Hamad al-Ansari, from Sabah al-Mazni, from Harith ibn Hasira, from Al-Asbagh ibn Nabata, from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), who said: I heard him say:

Indeed, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) taught me one thousand gates of the permissible and the forbidden, of what has been and what will be until the Day of Resurrection. Each of these gates opens one thousand gates, so that makes one million gates. Thus, I acquired the knowledge of deaths, calamities, and the distinction of speech (Divine Decree).

key_terms.أَلْفَ بَابٍ: one thousand gates (metaphor for categories of knowledge)
key_terms.الْحَلَالِ وَالْحَرَامِ: the permissible and the forbidden (jurisprudential rulings)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali learn from the Prophet regarding the scope of halal and haram knowledge?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) describes the comprehensive nature of the Prophet’s teaching, emphasizing the hierarchical structure of divine law where one thousand primary gates of halal and haram expand into a million sub-gates. This tradition underscores the Shia belief in the Prophet’s impartation of esoteric and exoteric knowledge, including 'Ilm al-Manaya' (knowledge of deaths and trials), which validates the Imam’s role as the inheritor of all divine decrees. The reference to 'Fasl al-Khitab' (the decisive word) highlights the clarity and finality of this transmitted knowledge, distinguishing it from general prophetic revelation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-20 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father and Muhammad ibn al-Hassan - may God be pleased with them - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd and Ibrahim ibn, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Himad al-Ansari, on the authority of Sabah al-Mazny, on the authority of Harith ibn Hasira, on the authority of Al-Asbaq al-Nobatat that he had heard the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) say, “God’s Prophet (MGB)

taught me one-thousand gates to the forbidden and the legitimate, what has been and what shall come all the way up until the Resurrection Day. Each of these gates opened up to one-thousand gates, so that they turned into one million gates. Thus, I acquired the knowledge of deaths, calamities and the Divine Decrees.”
